note: Birth places the automatic geocoder could not place, positioned by hand so they appear on the Origins map. Loaded into geocode_cache at start-up with status 'manual'. Never overwrites a place the geocoder found, or one somebody placed by hand in the database; a place from this file is refreshed if its entry here changes. Positions are the town or village centre as it stands now. Where the census text is ambiguous the note says which place was chosen.

places.label: Kirklington, Nottinghamshire
places.note: Taken as the Nottinghamshire village near Southwell; there are others of the name in Yorkshire and Cumberland.

places.label: Didsbury, Manchester
places.note: Recorded as Cheshire; Didsbury was in Lancashire, and is now in Manchester.

places.label: Geldeston, Norfolk (approximate)
places.note: A small parish near Loddon; placed to within a few miles.

places.label: Ilkeston, Derbyshire
places.note: Recorded as Nottinghamshire; Ilkeston is just over the border in Derbyshire.

places.label: Wiggenhall St Mary Magdalen, Norfolk
places.note: Taken as Wiggenhall St Mary Magdalen, the Norfolk parish usually shortened to Magdalen.

places.label: Strasbourg, France
places.note: German between 1871 and 1918, when the census recorded it; French now.

places.label: Wales (country only)
places.note: No town given; placed in the middle of Wales.

places.label: Churchtown, Southport, Merseyside
places.note: The Churchtown in Southport, Lancashire at the time and Merseyside now — identified by A. Hagues, not the Churchtown by Garstang.

places.label: Burnfoot, by Roberton, Scottish Borders (approximate)
places.note: Identified by A. Hagues as the hamlet on the Borthwick Water near Roberton, west of Hawick, though the census gives Stirling. Placed to within a mile or two.

places.label: Germany
places.note: The bracket records that the person was a naturalised or British subject, not part of the place name. Kept because the distinction matters among the German lace merchants of The Park; positioned on Germany.

places.label: Germany
places.note: As above: a nationality note the record keeps on purpose. Positioned on Germany.

places.label: Germany
places.note: As above: a nationality note the record keeps on purpose. Positioned on Germany.

places.label: France

places.label: France
places.note: Born in France but a British subject. Positioned on France.

places.note: Born in Belgium but a British subject. Positioned on Belgium.

places.label: Schleswig-Holstein, Germany
places.note: Positioned on Schleswig-Holstein. The naturalisation note is kept because it is the fact worth having.

places.label: Dundee, Scotland
places.note: Forfarshire is the old name for Angus; the census gives both. Positioned on Dundee.
